analysis.session_summary: Overnight tape was dominated by a sharp yen sell-off after an in-line BOJ Policy Rate +1 more; JPY fell 0.778% against majors, driving USD/JPY +107.8 pips to 157.133 and CHF/JPY +163.8 pips. Risk appetite stayed firm with SPX +17.4 and VIX -16.5, while high-beta FX gained and USD was flat. Commodity-linked AUD and CHF led, while NZD lagged. Most individual legs lacked clear catalysts, except the BOJ statement and RBA remarks contributing to late moves.

themes.evidence: JPY -0.778% vs majors; USD/JPY +107.8 pips to 157.133; CHF/JPY +163.8 pips
SPX +17.4, VIX -16.5; USD +0.005% vs majors; USD/MXN -471.0
AUD +0.265%, CHF +0.204%, GBP +0.180%; AUD/USD +16.1 pips, GBP/USD +20.3 pips

leg_notes.EUR/USD: Opened with a small 3.9-pip up leg, gave back 5.3 pips, then rallied 12.7 pips into the close with BOJ Policy Rate contributing +4.0 in 15 min (31% of that leg), netting +10.6 pips.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: Initial 19.8-pip down leg was reversed by a 125.6-pip up leg that was 39% BOJ-statement-driven in the first 15 min (+48.9), leaving the pair near its highs at +107.8 pips.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: Two up legs flanked a small 6.4-pip pullback, with the final 17.5-pip up leg 29% BOJ-assisted, netting +20.3 pips.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: CHF strength dominated through a net -14.2 pip move, with the largest down leg -22.1 pips near the BOJ statement and only minor bounces.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: After a 5.2-pip dip, AUD/USD climbed 21.3 pips with RBA Bullock and BOJ Policy Rate contributions, closing +16.1 pips.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: A 4.9-pip initial rise gave way to a 15.8-pip BOJ-assisted decline before a small bounce, netting -3.0 pips.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: Five choppy legs left NZD/USD nearly flat at -0.3 pips, with a 23.9-pip up leg after BOJ statement largely faded.
leg_notes.EUR/CHF: EUR/CHF netted -7.7 pips after two up legs were wiped out by a BOJ Policy Rate leg that moved the other way.
leg_notes.CHF/JPY: One 178.6-pip up leg, with +58.8 in 15 min from the BOJ statement (33% of the leg), drove CHF/JPY +163.8 pips.
leg_notes.AUD/NZD: A 63.4-pip up leg with BOJ Policy Rate help (+11.5, 18%) met a late 19.4-pip pullback, netting +29.2 pips.
leg_notes.EUR/GBP: EUR/GBP traded in an 11.2-pip range; the only clear catalyst was a BOJ-statement down leg with -1.5 in the first 15 min (71% of the leg), closing -5.2 pips.
leg_notes.AUD/CHF: A 21.5-pip up leg helped by RBA Bullock and BOJ was partly reversed by a 5.6-pip late dip, leaving AUD/CHF +3.1 pips.
leg_notes.NZD/CHF: NZD/CHF alternated lower and higher in five legs with no dominant catalyst, netting -8.5 pips.
leg_notes.USD/SEK: USD/SEK fell in two large down legs around an up leg, netting -183.7 pips with no single catalyst owning the move.
leg_notes.USD/NOK: Three legs netted -115.2 pips, with the final down leg 54% BOJ-assisted (-56.5 in 15 min).
leg_notes.USD/ZAR: A large 363.4-pip down leg after the BOJ rate news dominated, leaving USD/ZAR -358.1 pips.
leg_notes.USD/MXN: USD/MXN fell 471.0 pips, with a 318.2-pip down leg 35% BOJ-assisted during the BOJ announcement window.
leg_notes.Brent/USD: Brent was the weakest liquid asset at -97.4 pips despite a mid-session 54.1-pip bounce; lower highs prevailed with no clear FX catalyst.

polarity_reads.read: In-line, but JPY weakened 0.193%; the market was positioned for a hawkish surprise and instead sold JPY when none arrived, signalling yen downside was the path of least resistance.
Unscored, but AUD strengthened 0.067%; with no forecast to score, this flags positive AUD sensitivity to labor-market hawkish signals.
